description: Line diff of two texts as a unified diff with added/removed counts. Computes a minimal line-based diff (LCS) between two texts and returns unified-diff hunks with configurable context, plus counts of added and removed lines. Up to 5,000 lines per side. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
